articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Techniques in Respiratory Healthcare Services: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Death rate associated with respiratory diseases is a global concern. The various challenges incorporated in respiratory health management are due to delayed and inaccurate diagnosis. The availability of voluminous healthcare data has generated the opportunity for the application of numerous artificial intelligence based methodologies. These methods have shown the potential to address and cope several concerns in healthcare like timely predictions, accurate diagnosis, precise monitoring, clinical support, robotic surgeries etc. In the recent years, the alarming rise in number of people suffering from respiratory health problems has become an issue of great concern but the appropriate diagnostic strategies may help to reduce the severity of the disease. This paper provides an overview of the prevalent usage of emerging artificial intelligence based techniques, with the primary focus on applications in respiratory healthcare domain, where it can be used to evaluate lung images as well as respiratory sound and textual datasets for diagnosis of disease.

articleTitle: Internet of Things and Blockchain Technologies in the Insurance Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: With cutting-edge technologies like Blockchain technology, the Internet of Things (IoT), and Artificial Intelligence, the insurance industry is entering a new era of advancements. Financial innovations are widely affecting economic activities. IoT and blockchain technologies are considerably aiding the expansion of the insurance industry in this new era. This article examines the impact of IoT and blockchain technologies on the insurance industry and describes the phenomena from several angles. Digital insurers are growing more popular now, but it is essential to understand the problems and challenges they face, which result in poor penetration. Although there are many advantages for the insured and insurer, internet insurance providers are subject to operational, regulatory, and company reputation. Customers worry about the safety of their transactions and identity theft. This article aims to illustrate the fundamentals and the significance of IoT and blockchain technologies in the insurance business, looking at the benefits that accrue to the insurance provider and the customer. The findings of the study observed that Blockchain technology helps reduce insurers’ administrative costs of insurers and ensure the insured person’s claim adjustment. On the other hand, the Internet of Things helps to share more information about the clients and mitigate risk.

articleTitle: Game Development using Unity Game Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Unity is a professional and multi-platform gaming engine. It has become very popular in recent years. It has audio, video, graphics, lighting effects, and physical effects that can simulate the physical world, making the user feel immersive. Unity has gain popularity because of its rich community. It has in built physics and rigid body features that make it unique from other game engines. Applications and products developed by using Unity are used in film production, game development, and in the education sector. Different interfaces and scripting languages of Unity are explored in this article. Finally, it is researched that Unity is amongst most demanding game engines because of its largest users community. Fours applications developed by using Unity are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Two Layered Deep Long Short-Term Memory Network based Gold Rate Divination
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: From the moment of its discovery, gold has been the most significant and valuable commodity. The exact forecasting of gold price in the market remains a major challenge for the researchers to focus upon. With this motivation, this paper propose a novel Dual Coping Deep Long Short-Term Memory Network to forecast the gold price with minimum mean squared error. The model utilize the Daily gold price historical dataset retrieved from the KAGGLE machine-learning repository. The Daily gold price historical dataset contains 7 features with 5837 gold price details and is processed with missing values and encoding. The exploratory data analysis have done to visualize how the independent features are related to the gold price. The proposed Dual Coping Deep Long Short-Term Memory (DC-DLSTM) Network had designed with two LSTM overlay that recognizes short- and long-term relationships and convolutional layers retrieves the meaningful information from time-series gold price data and comprehending its internal representation. The Daily gold price historical data have applied to proposed model, same data was applied to other regressor models, and the performance metrics was analyzed. Implementation was scripted using python through NVidia Tesla V100 GPU workstation with 30 training epochs and batch size of 64. The performance metrics utilized for analysis are Mean squared error. Experimental results shows that the proposed DC-DLSTM shows the least mean squared error of 0.0013 when compared with other regressor models.

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation of Plant Disease Detection using Hashing based Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Agriculture is the main source of the Andhra Pradesh state economy. The agriculture industry heavily depends on crop production. But, many of the plants suffer from several diseases. Contaminated crops are mostly to blame for food loss, which consequently slows down the development of the agricultural industry. Recently in 2022, Both AP & Telangana face 40-80% of damage to chili crops due to pest attacks also informed in Parliament. It is very challenging for farmers to identify diseases in plants at the beginning stages. The assembly of the product and the market's economic value will be severely harmed by erroneous identification. There are many existing solutions to this problem associated with a mobile phones. But most of them are limited to the detection of plant diseases with a smaller number of categories of plants. The goal of this system is to detect plant diseases from images of the plant's leaves by developing a mobile application for the Andhra Pradesh state region, which will assist farmers in using appropriate pesticides for that disease. This involves the detection of plant disease based on the classification of leaf images using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. So, farmers can easily detect plant diseases in the early stages and use pesticides to treat those plants, which helps gain the economy. The dataset is the PlantVillage dataset under Kaggle which contains leaf images of various plants. The model is enhanced by hashing using the SHA-256 algorithm. The input data to the hash function is a leaf image which is in bytes format. The proposed model achieves integrity by using SHA-256. This model allows the identification of plant diseases that are tamper-proof.

articleTitle: AI Based Chatbot for Hospital Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The healthcare sector represents one of the most significant segments of the economy. A reliable healthcare system ensures a strong economy by increasing life expectancy, contributing to national growth, and reducing the burden of families. The purpose of this project is to implement a proper healthcare management system integrating all the basic functionalities powered by an Artificial Intelligent chatbot that is capable of having a very organic conversation with the user and solving their queries using knowledge base. The knowledge base is a real-time data collected in a JSON format which is pre-processed to make it ready for further processing using bag of words. The information is received and delivered in both speech and text formats. The chatbot can provide navigation links according to the requests of a user. Furthermore, it is capable of predicting the problem by performing symptom diagnosis and recommending a doctor to be consulted or any immediate measures to be taken. In addition, it also provides information regarding diagnostics beforehand.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Analysis of Head Mounted Displays for VR Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: A Virtual Reality (VR) is a fully immersive computer-simulated environment that provides users with the feeling of being in a real world though they are in a virtual environment. It is widely used to train novices in defense, healthcare, automobiles, and other sectors. The essence of VR is in the perception of the real world. To perceive the virtual world as the real world, there are certain key factors. One of such factors is the Head Mounted Displays (HMDs). HMDs are vital for the creation of an immersive experience. One of the most important factors is the selection of an appropriate HMD, with the help of which one can experience the VR applications. Various types of HMDs are available in the market. This article provides a comparative analysis of different types of HMDs and proposes one among them as the most suitable HMDs for research work.

articleTitle: Modified Unexpended Energy Based Stable Cluster Head Selection for Homogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs)
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The LEACH protocol is a random cluster head (CH) selection method that is an imposing way to give the cluster head opportunity among the nodes. In such randomization number of CHs vary in a wide range. In the worst case, the LEACH protocol gives zero CHs. The different LEACH-based protocols are developed, such as E-LEACH and RCH-LEACH, where unexpended energy of nodes is considered in CHs selection for efficient energy utilization and coverage enhancement. In these algorithms, the CHs selection methods improve the performance parameters, mainly the coverage, network lifetime, FND, HND, and LND, but the poor lower bound on CHs adversely affects the performance parameters of the network. This article proposed a LEACH-based improved algorithm for CH selection and used the unexpended node energy as an essential parameter for stabilizing the cluster heads. The proposed algorithm improves the lower bound on CHs and gives a stable 5% cluster head count. The simulation result shows that the stable cluster head count improves the FND, LND, and alive node performance of the wireless sensor network compared to the LEACH, E-LEACH, and RCH-LEACH algorithms.

articleTitle: Personalized Emotion Detection from Text using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Social media platforms have evolved into essential tools for sharing emotions with the rest of the globe. People utilize text, photos, music, and video to express their emotions or their points of view. On the Internet, these social media platforms generate a vast volume of unstructured data. All the existing emotion detection models based on the supervised learning methodology require to collect labelled data which is time- consuming task. Next, for languages that are underutilized in terms of NLP, such as Polish vocabulary. To tackle these issues, this paper presents a model that functions as an emotional awareness system. It is based on open forums with automated audio information and text analysis for user-based emotion detection. The model is a key component of many natural computer programmers for processing natural language. The proposed model is implemented using PocketSphinx as an ASR. In addition to this, the model also uses the Word2Vec model, K-means clustering, and the Term frequency-inverse document Vectorizer for text analysis and segmentation. Further, the data from the International Survey on Emotion Antecedents and Reactions (ISEAR) was used to test and train the model. Finally, the concept evolves into a user-based system that will act as a personal assistant for segregating people's emotions as they experiment with new apps. The ISEAR database will be used for performance testing. When utilized in the database, the suggested model greatly outperforms previous models, with an accuracy of 80.25 percent and an F1 score accuracy of 88.86 percent. As the future work, this algorithm can be integrated into an application where emotion is used for recommendation.

articleTitle: Cost Optimized Design of Full Adder in QCA Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The use of electronic devices in our day to day life is increasing rapidly. Everyone wants gadgets with higher battery life and high speed. To optimze power usage, one of the promising technology is QCA (Quantum-Dot Cellular Automata) in which the information is propagated in terms of propagation of polarization between QCA cells. This is due to the Coulombic interaction of electrons between successive QCA cells. In digital electronics, full adder is considered as a key component to perform mathematical and logical calculation inside the ALU. Considering the importance of addition, here an optimized design of cell interaction based QCA full adder is presented. The design is optimized as it utilizes less number of QCA cells, Majority gate, inverter and crossover. QCA designer tool is used for simulations and the results are also compared with previous designs, which also proves the efficacy of presented work.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Sentiment Analysis and Classification of Restaurant Reviews
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: In this study, we performed sentiment analysis on restaurant reviews. To dine, we all go to restaurants with our loved ones and friends. However, we decide which restaurant to eat at before going there. Consequently, we select restaurants based on the reviews left by previous customers. A restaurant is a business, and the owner welcomes feedback from diners regarding their dining experiences so they may adjust their menu and amenities accordingly. Sentiment analysis is used to categories reviews as either good or negative, depending on whether they will have an impact on other people. Sentiment Analysis uses a machine learning algorithm and natural language processing to determine if a review is good or negative. It aids in the careful investigation of a scenario or service's good and negative effects, allowing for the suggestion of modifications. Both in terms of increasing consumer satisfaction and the caliber of the services offered, this might be advantageous. The user experience will be better as a result. This paper offers a study of key factors that distinguish between favorable and unfavorable assessments. This paper analyses various Machine Learning techniques that successfully analyze these reviews. In this study, we employed K-nearest neighbours Classifier, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Classifier (Gaussian NB and Multinomial NB), and Naive Bayes algorithm. A dataset from Kaggle was used in this study. Here, we will be able to observe which machine learning (ML) methods, can give more accurate results. We will also be able to evaluate how well an NLP can predict a sentiment from the given text. By illustrating how computers attempt to comprehend human sentiments, this article examines the possibilities. Out of everything, SVM produced an accuracy of 78 percent.

articleTitle: Music Stream Analysis for the Prediction of Song Popularity using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Music streaming services have increased in popularity due to ubiquitous demand of web and smart devices. Music lovers are inclined towards a variety of music styles and leave a different digital trail. The emotional responses that music can evoke in its listeners can result in both physiological adjustment and cognitive benefits. The world’s largest streaming service, Spotify, is the subject of this research. In this study, a model to predict whether a music would be featured on Hit-50 list of Spotify charts. This study employs the plotly for exploratory data analysis, offer descriptive statistical analysis, and compare machine learning approach with deep learning approach utilising Spotify data of eight months. Further, the study also identified several important features and correlation between them.

articleTitle: Gray Hole Attack Detection and Prevention System in Vehicular Adhoc Network (VANET)
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: VANET is at the core of intelligent transportation system. Numerous issues, particularly in the area of communication security, are raised by vehicle communication. During the exchange of safety information among vehicular nodes, malicious attacks have the potential to alter or delete the data which may cause even life threat to the commuters. Therefore, it is important to recognize and eliminate these attacks. The role of the router for associated nodes played by each node of the VANET, that allowing a malicious node to compromise network security by sending false routing messages to nodes. In this paper, we focus on gray hole attack in which the malicious nodes drop packets randomly making it hard to detect. Though the problem has been addressed using AODV protocol but VANET being dynamic in nature poses challenges in detection. We propose the detection and prevention mechanism of gray hole attack in VANET communication system through NS2 network simulator. Along with the security the proposed methodology helps in enhancing the performance of the network by improving parameters such as packet delivery ratio and throughput.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of State Dependent Queueing based Geospatial Mist-assisted Cloud System for Crime Data Visualisation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Modern Information and Communication Technology enables an expansion of real-time geospatial applications. These applications must process at the network’s edge, not on the central cloud servers, due to their sensitivity to latency and QoS. Mist nodes are capable of caching frequently requested, low-volume geospatial data and processing them with lightweight applications. Display the geospatial data processing results on the client’s devices or systems in accordance with their specifications. Mist and fog computing are the subject of extensive research, particularly in geospatial application contexts. Real-time geospatial applications include weather forecasting, health surveillance, disaster management, and crime analysis. This paper proposes the geospatial mist-assisted cloud system for the visualisation of crime data. This paper also offers a unique analytical model that studies state-dependent service queuing systems with geospatial mist-assisted cloud systems and the effect of state-dependent service time on the overall performance of the system. It explains some of the system’s attributes, and numerical evaluations and simulations verify the system’s viability. Using a geospatial mist assisted cloud system, the proposed system achieves an acceptable level of precision and successfully offloads duties, according to the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Estimating 3D Human Pose using Point Based Pose Estimation and Single Stage Method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Graphically estimating a person's pose is a computer vision task called human pose estimation. Predicting the location of a person's body parts or joints is an everyday use case for this method. The vast number of potential uses for this kind of technology has made it one of the most intriguing areas of study in computer vision. To estimate a human's 3D stance from 2D photos, the location of the important body joints in 3D space shall be determined. Despite extensive research in the field of computer vision, this issue continues to pose significant difficulties. This is because the depth information is lost when obtaining 2D images of 3D objects, leading to ambiguity. While using a 2D Image as input, only a portion of a person's body is exhibited; estimating their 3D position is challenging. In this study, we offer methods for recovering a human's 3D position from a 2D photograph when just a portion of the body is visible. Any situation where some of the body's major joints are outside the image’s bounds is considered a partial body presence. The presence of these joints in the input image is also detected by a CNN network that we propose. We propose integrating the two networks to determine the full human posture in 3 Dimensional Space and the partial 3D human pose calculated by the detection network. Comparing our experimental results to those of the state-of-the-art demonstrates the efficacy of our methods in the presence of a partially-occluded body. Furthermore, the experimental results show that the 3D human posture may be estimated more accurately from 2D pictures using a linear regression rather than an intermediary stage of 2D pose estimation.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategies of Hybrid Power System Under Varying Load Conditions- An Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Traditional energy sources are being depleted day by day therefore generating electricity through conventional sources is becoming more expensive. The world moves towards renewable energy (RE) sources, their impact is becoming more and more important like less cost, abundant availability in nature, minimum losses. Due to abnormal weather conditions & fault in transmission line the supply of electricity is interrupted. Under this condition, the main challenge is to ensure reliable energy supply and this can only be done by the use of RE source. But the main problem for the generation of electricity through RE sources is that the load requirement cannot be fulfilled by the use of only one RE sources like solar, wind or hydro because the availability of these sources affected by the weather condition. The load requirement can only be fulfilled by using hybrid energy sources. The manuscript deals with energy management strategy for the educational institute under varying loading conditions. This paper mainly focuses on the configuration and analysis of hybrid energy system using energy management strategy.

articleTitle: Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis of PCC-based Change detection methods over Agricultural land using Sentinel-2 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: To plan production, the sowing, and harvesting of a particular crop, and the performance of marketing activities information about yields is important for both the traders and producers. In this study, various efforts have been made to extract critical information for agriculture land use classification areas using Sentinel-2 datasets, which was not possible with the help of multi-spectral datasets. As part of the current work, the artificial neural networks (ANN) classifier is combined with the post-classification comparison (PCC), thereby predicting seasonal variability from satellite imagery. The ANN classifier is incorporated into the post-classification comparison procedure, called ANN-based change detection. As part of the demonstration, the datasets were acquired using Sentinel-2 datasets during the period 2017 – 2018 over the agricultural land in Block Khamanon, District Fatehgarh Sahib, Punjab State, India. This process cross-validated the performance of ANN with a conventional maximum likelihood classifier (MLC) for confirmation. In comparison with the conventional PCC-MLC model (classified maps have an average of 86 – 88.8%, and change maps have an average of 83.6 – 84.2%), the PCC-ANN model achieved accuracy (classified maps have an average of 90.4 – 93.4%, and change maps have an average of 87.4 – 90%). In addition to identifying water surfaces, crop types, and man-made features, this study can also help in performing a wide range of land-use patterns.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Ensemble Learning Classifiers for Parkinson’s Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: A neurological illness called Parkinson's disease (PD) commonly appears between the ages of 55 and 65. Moreover, a patient's entire quality of life is significantly impacted by the progressive development of motor as well as non-motor symptoms due to this disease. There is no known cure for PD, although a number of therapies have been created to assist control its symptoms. Therefore, the management of PD is a field that is expanding, and there is a need to develop a comprehensive framework for the timely detection and classification of PD. In this paper, we developed six machine learning-based and five ensemble learning-based classification models to forecast PD. The six base classifiers which are used in the current study are Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Trees (DTs), Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Logistic Regression (LR), Naive Bayes (NB); and five ensemble classifiers named XGBoost, Gradient Boost, Bagging, CatBoost and Light Gradient Boosted Machine (LGBM) respectively, are then carefully compared. To improve the performance of the classifiers and to reduce the problem of overfitting, a feature selection method named Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and various preprocessing techniques are applied. Further, this study uses the voice samples dataset from the UCI repository having 188 PD and 64 normal patients. Overall, our findings revealed that, when compared to the other five base classifiers, the RF model offered the best classification performance with an accuracy of 82.37%, and the ensemble classifier named LGBM shows best results when compared with base as well as ensemble classifiers having an accuracy of 85.90%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Framework for COVID Protocol Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is now penetrating into all the domains. Any domain can incorporate artificial intelligence to automate their process. In the outbreak of COVID pandemic, artificial intelligence has been very useful in many ways. artificial intelligence helps in automating process where it’s not always possible for people to do and to reduce the wastage of human resource. Here we proposed a frame work to automate the detection of covid protocol violation in public places. Our work detecting people with & without masks and detects social distancing with a single model. The best performing model from the standard convolution neural network architectures namely VGG16 and MobileNetV2 are used in the present work, from the experiments it’s found that MobileNetV2 outperformed VGG16. The developed system can easily be integrated/implemented on various embedded devices with limited computational capacity by using the MobileNetV2 architecture. Compared to other previous works, our work outstands by having good accuracy and compatible to use in real life application because of its requirement of less computational complexity.

articleTitle: UEBA with Log Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Organizations are shifting to the cloud rapidly to enable digital business opportunities. The cloud's dynamic environment helps them cope with the rapidly changing business environment. But the lack of visibility and detection capabilities raises security concerns for the organizations. UEBA(User Behavior and Entity Analysis) helps the organization understand user behaviour with transparency and detect deviations if any. Many organizations are adopting AWS for cloud migration as it is evaluated as a leader in the market. Therefore this paper will also discuss a case study for the analysis of user behaviours based on their activities. The proposed method detects anomalous behaviour and also categorizes the user based on their activity patterns.

articleTitle: Labour Exploitation Investigation using Satellite based Vessel Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Taiwan is one of the most extensive distant water fishing (DWF) and has more than 1,000 ships producing 40 billion N.T. dollars. More than 90% of Taiwanese fishermen are recruited from Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. However, labour exploitation has become a severe problem in the Taiwan distant water fishing (DWF) industry. The Taiwan government recently amended the law and stipulated that multiple CCTV cameras be installed on DWF vessels to protect against labour abuse. Current technology only records videos captured by CCTV cameras. Thus, detecting labour abuse is nearly impossible. To resolve this problem, we have developed a deep neural network model to predict labour abuse in DWF. The developed model uses satellite-based vessel monitoring systems data for the predictions of labour abuse. The proposed deep neural network model gives better prediction than logistic regression, support vector machine, Random Forest and decision tree.

articleTitle: Power Transfer using WPT Technique for Electrical Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Electromagnetic power transfer or Wireless power transfer (WPT) is the phenomenon in which electrical energy is transferred from the source of power directed towards an electrical load unaccompanied by a wire. This wireless charging system for automobiles has been in progress for several years. Today, WPT is more reliable, required low maintenance cost, and further could be utilized for short-range as well as long-range transmission. This paper aims to propose a system using magnetic resonance to avoid annoying wires and to transfer utmost power to electric vehicles and improve the driving range of the vehicle. The initial charging method consumes more time and also limits the driving range. In the past decade, a lot of research has been done on this subject and a huge segment has been explored. An overview regrading inductive wireless power transfer is examined for electric vehicles in this research paper. This paper consists of a detailed discussion on wireless power transfer techniques including IPT, RIPT, and magnetic coupler. The simulation is done in MATLAB for the proposed model.

articleTitle: Development of a Covid-19 Information Dashboard to Access the Health Care Resources and Requirements Online
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: With the emergence of coronavirus and the rapidly increasing number of cases, we observed that people were suffering from a lack of information about where to source critical requirements such as oxygen cylinders, beds, ambulance service, and ventilators. In this research paper and project, the authors have designed and developed an interactive information dashboard to access the availability of these resources and requirements at different locations across India from myriad sources. The information dashboard will show information for all the states across India. The dashboard visualizes the number of corona cases, hospital beds, blood bank, etc. The end-users and the COVID-19 support team can imagine all the requirements in the dashboard that is factual and credible within their vicinity from multiple information sources. The user need not search various information sites to search for different conditions. The project collates the data of other requirements from primary sources of information like Twitter and government websites and lists them on the dashboard. The authors used open-source programming and database technologies to display the data per user requirements. The dashboard was helpful to the end-users during COVID-19 times in terms of convenient accessibility and efficiency.

articleTitle: Security for Wireless Sensor Networks : Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are mostly popular in a wide variety of applications and is used without any restrictions, that leads to serious security implications. Major concerns are localization, security, data aggregation, data integration, data calibration, fault tolerance and distributed denial of service attacks. It is important to explore the articles that are published by researchers about their concerns and the adopted methods used to solve the problem space. This paper includes a comprehensive bibliometric analysis to explore any uncovered areas. In recent days’ bibliometric analysis using R based bibliometric package is the most popular approach used in this research study. This research presents a) Annual Scientific Production, b) Annual Citations per Year c) Three-Fields Plot d) Most Relevant Sources e) Source H-Index f) Most Relevant Authors and their production over time g) Co-occurrence Network from trendy topic frequency h) Thematic Map. It is a quantitative research conducted on security for wireless sensor networks using dataset retrieved from Scopus database, it is all about the articles published during the period: 2002 and up-to the first quarter of 2022. A collection of 1654 articles are filtered using Search protocol and the same is based on PRISMA approach. After bibliometric analysis authors observations are that during the last two decades this being an interesting topic, there is a contributed growth of around 27.69% articles represents the demand. This survey paper provides a research roadmap for intended researchers.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Various Contrast Enhancement Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Contrast enhancement assumes an important part in image processing which makes an image more clear and bright. It essentially improves the image quality which makes the image's content easy to recognize. In this paper the analysis of four popular contrast enhancement techniques have been done to overcome the brightness and preservation issues and also keeps up the quality of the image. These four techniques are Histogram Equalization (HE), Brightness Preserving Bi- Histogram Equalization (BBHE), Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), and Recursive Mean-Separate Histogram Equalization (RMSHE). Additionally the work also shows the estimation of various parameters like: Signal to noise ratio (SNR), Mean square error (MSE), Root mean square error (RMSE), Mean absolute error (MAE), Peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR), and Structure similarity index (SSIM) for each technique.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of Data Aggregation using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are usually employed to address the data transfer using sensors nodes associated with dynamic environment. However, this data transmission gets significantly challenged when huge data need to be transferred via WSN. Numerous researchers had proposed various Data Aggregation (DA) schemes to resolve this issue, however, due to service quality and security factors it persisted to challenge the Quality-of-Service (QoS) delivered using WSN. The present review had discussed the concept and the process involved in DA. Further, the paper mainly surveyed the research published in the last decade for DA in WSN using Machine Learning (ML) approaches. The basic architecture involved in data transfer using nodes in while performing DA is discussed followed by the list of various ML approaches that have been implemented in the recent past for DA. The review is based on the articles published in various authenticated journals. Finally, the analysis is summarized to lay foundation of further research aimed at the enhancement of performance of data transmission via DA in WSN using ML approaches.

articleTitle: Study on Smart Security Measures in Threat and Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: SEP, more specifically Security Engineering Process, forms a part of the modern assessment and evaluation of related threats and risks, whether it is an agile form of development or SSDLC (Secure Software Development Life Cycle). While in today’s era we deal with modern concepts like cloud computing, remote processing, etc. kinds of strategies which involve data at rest and data in motion, and data computation-intensive tasks. Threat and Risk Assessment are closely related to different attack values in which an attacker can perform actions in order to gain additional privileges to your system, software, cloud etc. Threat and Risk Assessment of different projects including web applications development, cloud onboarding, requires accessing the project at the design level so that the product is more specifically secure in the terms of compliance and the coding techniques used are in accordance with the secure coding guidelines. This paper focuses on the comparison of various standardized threat and risk assessment techniques with respect to dynamic threats and possible risk mitigations.

articleTitle: Predicting Sorption Behavior in Edible Bionanocomposite Films with Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Two machine learning (ML) algorithms, viz., neural network (NN) and support vector regression (SVR) machine have been experimentally investigated to intelligently predict sorption isotherms in a biodegradable nanocomposite food packaging material. These materials were developed using dairy residuals with byproducts, which were, otherwise, wasted by the industry. The predication performances of the ML models were compared with that of conventional mathematical sorption methods, viz., Brunauer–Emmitt–Teller (BET) and Guggenhiem–Anderson–de Boer (GAB) models. The prediction efficiency of the ML models, expressed in terms of coefficient of determination (R<sup>2</sup>), mean absolute error (MAE), percent root mean squared error (%RMSE) and Accuracy (%), were experimentally found to be in the range of 0.99-1.0, 0.11-0.76, 0.32-9.78, and 82.41-100, against that of the conventional sorption models being in the range of 0.96-0.99, 0.03-1.98, 0.72-10.28, and 43.34-100, respectively. Evidently, the ML models performed fairly better than the conventional sorption methods.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Predictive Maintenance using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: In the recent times, industrial automation has accelerated the use of sophisticated and contemporary machine tools. Rotating machines are the most critical equipment in today's modern industry set-ups. Operating conditions of these equipment must be maintained in order to avoid production interruptions and financial loss. Rotating machines operate for extended periods of time, and as a result, they frequently experience mechanical and electrical stresses. Because of these electrical and mechanical stresses, various parts of rotating machines will fail. Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms have been used effectively in industry for predictive maintenance of machines to increase the operational reliability and reduced costs. In this research paper, the problem of predictive maintenance using the IMS bearing dataset from NASA Prognostic Data Repository is undertaken and Long-short term memory (LSTM) model is deployed. For this purpose, root means square (RMS) value is taken as condition indicator of the machine which is provided the information about machine’s health. KernelRidge regression is introduced for comparing its result with LSTM based model. After exhaustive simulation and the simulation performance measures in terms of root means square error (RMSE) score of training, validation and testing set are 0.0017, 0.0101 and 0.0012 respectively for proposed LSTM model.

articleTitle: Security Risk Assessment & Mitigation Framework for Cloud-based IT Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: More often than not, the need for security is realized only after the system has been broken. Adding security afterwards is often difficult and much costlier and sometimes, nearly impossible. Hence, Security needs to be embedded into an IT system in order to develop secure IT systems which is possible only when a Security Engineering Framework is well defined for the entire lifecycle of an IT system. In this Paper, we have designed and developed an implementable Framework for Security Engineering of Cloud-based IT Systems. Cloud-based IT Systems are vulnerable to a plethora of cyber-attacks because of their accessibility and their services exposed in a multi-tenant environment. The Cloud-based IT Systems Security Risk Assessment & Mitigation Framework (CISSRAMF) is agnostic to Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) as well as to the type of Services provided, i.e., Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS). CISSRAMF encompasses the entire lifecycle of any Cloud-based IT System right from the conception phase till decommissioning of the system. CISSRAMF utilizes the Standards for Information Security and Cybersecurity like ISO/IEC 27001:2013, ISO/IEC 27002:2013, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) Project.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Combat COVID-19 using Smart-ID-Cards
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: COVID-19, A Pandemic with its increasing pace has spread across the globe. The medical care system was badly hit by it as the number of patients fared the number of available hospital beds and other facilities required to treat patients. To rescue, various Internet of Things (IoT) based devices were proposed to combat COVID-19 by offering a helping hand to the medical care system. The pace at which the death rate was increasing, it became the need to combat the root cause of COVID-19, the root cause being the quick spread. ID-Card though not so famous IoMT (Internet of Medical Things) device can be made to work smart, smart enough to monitor the home isolated patients, to keep a check on a precautionary distance measure and much more. The study aims to explore and discuss the state-of-the-art of various IoT to control the novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) spread by tracing out positive patients and stopping this chain by tracing symptoms just a click away. The IoMT Smart-ID-Card is proposed to easefully detect, monitor, and combat COVID-19.

articleTitle: Logarithmic Estimators in Small Area for Estimation of Population Mean
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Small area estimation is a branch of statistical science that integrates survey sampling, statistical models, and inference about a finite population. The necessity for small area estimating approaches has also emerged as a result of agricultural development planning for rapid production increase, etc. For improved estimates and to increase the accuracy of the estimators, information from an auxiliary variable that is highly associated with the variable under study may be readily available. As a result, sample surveys frequently use auxiliary information to estimate parameters of interest in small areas. Numerous researchers have suggested a wide range of estimators using various methodologies. This study aims to provide logarithmic type estimators for small areas that estimate the population mean for straightforward random sampling techniques using data on a single auxiliary variable. For the logarithmic estimators, the bias and mean square error have been computed. Proposed estimators are shown to be more effective than other widely used estimators in specific real-world settings. The fact that these estimators reduce to regression estimators is also shown. To demonstrate the proposed estimators' superiority over other exciting estimators, numerical results of their efficiency are shown as percent relative efficiencies (PRE).

articleTitle: Estimation of Rain Attenuation over 10 GHz to 80 GHz Radio Band
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The major challenge faced by wireless signal propagation is the attenuation of radio signals due to atmospheric phenomenon like rain, snow, dust and clouds. Attenuation caused by rainfall is the main factor affecting the reliability of communication system beyond 10 GHz. This paper evaluates the performance of rain attenuation models, namely ITU-R model and Crane model using experimental formulations. The degradation in wireless signal propagation due to rain is determined using the above-mentioned models at different rain rates. Further, the impact of elevation angle and vertical and horizontal polarization on the signal attenuation with varying frequencies is observed. In the end, both the models are compared for better performance. It is observed that ITU-R model outperforms the Crane model with minimum rain attenuation of 5.0541dB at 10 GHz at rain rate of 20 mm/hr. With increase in rain rate, the attenuation increases with maximum attenuation observed for rain rate of 100 mm/hr at 80 GHz. Also, the effect of elevation angle and polarization on signal attenuation due to rain suggests that ITU-R model is a better choice while evaluating the wireless signal propagation in different rainfall conditions.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Web-based Tools for Multiple Sequence Alignment: A Comparative Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Multiple sequence alignment (MSA) is one of the oldest dilemmas in computational biology, involving the alignment of more than two DNA, RNA, or protein sequences. There are numerous methods for aligning multiple sequences. According to the survey, there are 103 free MSA Tools – Software, and Resources available. Many techniques are designed to maximize speed while ignoring alignment accuracy. Similarly, many techniques prioritize accuracy over speed. The MSA tool's goal is to reduce execution time and memory requirements while increasing the accuracy of MSA on large-scale data. Choosing which tools to use is one of the most difficult problems for bioinformaticians, especially for the majority of non-bioinformaticians. As a result, a comparison study of the various multiple sequence alignment tools is required so that biologists and bioinformaticians can correctly interpret their biological data using the appropriate tools. In order to determine which tool is best for multiple sequence alignment, we used a case study to evaluate various MSA tools.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis and Optimal Control of PZT Based Cantilever Beam Using Fuzzy-PID Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: In this study experimental analysis and control of a PZT based cantilever is performed using Fuzzy-PID controllers. Two PZT patches were attached to the rigid end of the Cantilever beam out of which one was used as an actuator and another PZT was used as a sensor. The sensor input was provided to a computer using an NI DAQ card. The sensor signal was received by the computer through LABVIEW software where the control algorithms using PID and Fuzzy-PID controller were designed. At the rigid end of the cantilever beam, a magnet was attached and an electromagnet was used as a controller for controlling the vibrations. The vibration suppression was done at the first order mode frequency of the cantilever beam and both PID and fuzzy-PID controllers show good suppression of the vibrations. However, the results show that fuzzy-PID controllers have better characteristics than PID control.

articleTitle: Evaluating Social Responsible Attitudes and Opinions using Sentiment Analysis – An Indian Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Most companies in India who are under the ambit of Companies Act 2013 are mandated to participate, communicate, and create social impact at the bottom of the pyramid, through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) has also gained prominence in academic research through several challenges exposed due to the mandated CSR in India. There are already several research studies were conducted to understand various aspects of CSR. Researchers in some studies carried out research with the help of methods and techniques of qualitative analysis from the data collected from traditional sources of communication like print media and electronic media. In recent times, social media has emerged as a compelling communication platform with its remarkable contribution to providing a haven for its users to express their freedom of speech. However, academic literature still lacks empirical research that show how companies in India are performing through social media communication. Among all the available social media platforms, Twitter is popular globally and most dominant for communication and impact. Also, since Twitter is widely used by all layers of society, from the most influential people and the most powerful organizations to the common person, and the tweets contain massive data. In this paper, the authors have used sentiment analysis for evaluating the communication of the Indian companies of Indian. The study is based on a sample of 9,000 plus Tweets during a month. Using the cloud based and sentiment analysis the authors have analyzed the communication of these companies.

articleTitle: A Survey on Identification of Hate Speech on Social Media Post
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: In the age of social media and mobile internet, the development of autonomous methods for online detection of hate speech or abusive language is vital for societal and community empowerment because social media is accessible worldwide via the internet. Anybody may simply attack someone or a group who adheres to a different culture or ideology on social media. While everyone has the freedom to express their own opinions, it should not be destructive, and everyone has the right to be free to say anything. To learn about hate speech, a review process include a large number of research articles which were published in the period of year 2017 to year 2022. After an exhaustive review process, we have found the common findings, strengths, weaknesses, gaps and solution approaches & their results.

articleTitle: Efficient Channel Management Scheme for Cognitive Radio based Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) are expected to enable communication between numerous devices in homes, workplaces, agricultural areas and industries, resulting in a significant rise in infrastructure requirements for IoT. Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is an essential component of IoT systems. The number of sensor nodes in the WSNs will grow rapidly as IoT expands. As these nodes interact wirelessly, they need frequency spectrum for communication, resulting in a growth in demand for frequency spectrum but not in its availability. To improve spectrum utilization, the proposed research describes a Cognitive Radio (CR) based channel assignment method for the WSNs. The suggested technique improves the channel utilization efficiency by distributing available frequency bands to wireless sensor nodes based on their bandwidth requirements. When the number of accessible channels is smaller than the number of active nodes, the presented method outperformed the previous schemes in terms of the number of successfully reporting nodes. For instance, 13 sensor nodes reported successfully for the proposed scheme when the number of accessible channels were 15 whereas not more than 7 nodes reported successfully in case of previous schemes.

articleTitle: Quality of Service Enhancement through Novel Energy Inception Aware Efficient Routing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Quality of Service is an emerging domain in the area of innovation to connect the things on the web without human intervention. The protocol design and Quality of Service are the two major concern that prevails in the communication between the IoT devices. The well-known IoT real applications had developed in various interdisciplinary fields extending the services in healthcare, smart wearables, smart city, agriculture and energy saving industries. Routing is the protocol method that extends the sharing the data between the IoT sensor devices. However, the efficient achievement of quality of service in the economic tradeoff remains a challenging issue with the researchers in developing the routing mechanism. With this overview, this paper propose a design architecture namely Energy Inception Aware Efficient Routing (EIAER) Method that delivers idle Quality of Service as outcome. The sensor devices had treated as nodes that had assumed as input nodes in the model. The sensor nodes are deployed and the application user can select the parent node. The input point have targeted as the source point and the distance between the nodes the determined from the source node. The energy of all the sensor nodes obtained from the routing table have used to compute the routing threshold. The routing threshold is compared with all the sensor nodes to pick the next source node for sharing the information. This process had iterated until the information had shared to the destination node. The implementation is done Contiki Operating System using Cooja Simulator to validate the performance metrics. The proposed Energy Inception Aware Efficient Routing method contributes in successful information sharing without any discrepancies in packet loss. Implementation results have discussed in the paper to that attains the maximum energy saving with reliability using Contiki.

articleTitle: Pre-trained CNN and SVM Based Hybrid Model for Apple Crops Phenological Phase Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: This study suggests a hybrid approach for identifying different phenological phases of apple crop development. This is one of the key research areas in agriculture. The proposed hybrid model combines a custom pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) and a supervised machine learning algorithm support vector machine (SVM). The custom pre-trained CNN model extracts the critical features from the images. Whereas, the SVM performs the task of classification. The hybrid model was trained on a custom dataset of RGB images of various principal phonological stages of apples from an orchard situated close to Srinagar airport, JK (UT), India. Images of the dataset were expanded using data augmentation methods. The expanded training dataset has more than 5000 images, the validation dataset has around 1400 images and the testing dataset has around 1750 images. The performance of the new hybrid model with other famous models like VGG16, VGG19, ResNet50, and Inception-v3 was compared. The suggested hybrid model has a better f1-score of 0.97.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection System Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The detection of drowsy drivers has been the approach for avoiding road accidents in recent years. The purpose of this study is to establish a method for building intelligent vehicles that can reduce drowsy driving impairment. Therefore, it is vital to develop a reliable warning system to prevent the incident's cause. In this proposed work, we provide a drowsy driver alert system developed using a way in which the video stream process (VSP) is evaluated by an inborn reflex construct applying an eye aspect ratio (EAR) and geometrical distance of the attention. An algorithmic technique based on facial landmarks is also applied for reliable eye recognition. When driver drowsiness is detected, the module delivers a warning message at the side of the crash impact and site information, notifying the voice surveillance system.

articleTitle: sluggishQCloud: Towards the Sluggish Queueing assisted Cloud System for Efficient Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The provision of computing resources such as com- puting power, storage, networking, and IT infrastructure dynamically and virtually by service providers over the Internet on a pay-per-use basis is known as cloud computing. Customers can send a lease to the cloud service provider via the internet to request cloud-based resources. Leases are resource provisioning abstractions that include all necessary resources, the provisioning time, and the customer’s budget, among other things, in termsof the quantity, capacity, and duration of nodes. The service provider then accepts all customer leases, generates virtual machines for them, and schedules them with the assistance of a lease manager. Lease managers utilize their algorithms to handle leases, which include scheduling leases. OpenNebula uses Haizea, an open-source VM-based leasing management framework, as a resource manager. It acknowledges the user’s lease request and subsequently arranges the lease according to the physical machines’ resource availability. It enables users to submit requests as leases. In haizea, preemptible best-effort leases can be supplanted by leases with a higher priority, such as those with an advanced reservation or an immediate lease. This article models each VM as a service provider and extracts its different performance metrics, including average number of request leasesin the system/ queue, the mean waiting time of the leases in the system/queue.

articleTitle: Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Images using Deep Neural Network and GAN Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Recently, some private images of a Hollywood stars leaked from icloud, for instance. There are two popular methods, secret writing and knowledge activity, for protecting picture contents against leakage. Despite secret writing’s ability to solve the privacy problem, its use is vulnerable to hackers due to the complexity and unique appearance of cypher languages. Data activity technology not only safeguards the data in a hidden file but also hides the communication method from an attacker by embedding it within a cover such as a picture, piece of music, or video. Reversible and irreversible unit knowledge activities exist. Reversible knowledge activity in images is a way for recovering the initial cover when embedded messages are extracted from encrypted images, such as image data, labels, or authentication data, without accessing the original contents. CNN and GAN (Generative Network) models will be utilized for training and evaluation. The initial image must be recovered in its entirety, and the disguised message must be extracted correctly at the receiving end. Numerous applications, including law enforcement, medical applications, such as keeping patient information discreet, and military applications, have a high demand for the physical property of hidden concealed knowledge. The original image must be recoverable without any quality loss, and the application must also allow for editing.

articleTitle: Small Area Estimation of Population Parameter under Stratified Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: A discipline of statistics known as small-area estimation (SAE) combines survey sampling and statistical models with finite population inference. Applications for SAE in statistics include the estimation of health statistics, the estimation of under-coverage in the census, the estimation of unemployment rates, the estimation of crop yield in agriculture, or the planning of agricultural development for rapidly increasing production, among numerous others. Using modified ratio cum regression type estimators and modified product cum regression type estimators in stratified sampling, it is suggested in this article that the population mean can be estimated for a small area using data on a single auxiliary variable. The effectiveness of the proposed estimator in comparison to the current estimators is tested, and the findings are demonstrated statistically and empirically to support the superiority of the proposed estimators.

articleTitle: IoT Platform Combined with Machine Learning Techniques for Fault Detection and Diagnosis of Large Photovoltaic Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The maintenance of solar photovoltaic plants is critical to ensure reliable energy production and to reach the competitiveness in the energy market. Maintenance in photovoltaic industry is evolving into new condition monitoring systems based on thermal cameras and unmanned aerial vehicles due to high acquisition rate. Novel fault detection techniques and data analysis methods are required to analyze large volumes of images and, therefore, data. The automatization of fault detection is a key factor to enhance maintenance activities. This work introduces a novel approach to develop an Internet of Things platform built with CakePHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript for hot spot detection of aerial thermographic images. This platform applies two consecutive artificial neural networks, and the methodology is tested with a real case study with thermal images from different photovoltaic solar plants. The analysis is performed in the platform, and the results obtained showed a 100% of accuracy for panel detection, and around 90% of accuracy for hot spot detection.

articleTitle: Routing Protocols in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Wireless Sensor networks (WSNs) emerging as a powerful technique for maintaining habitats in green spaces, getting information about actions in danger zones, keeping a close watch on infrastructure, including keeping a eye on suspicious behavior on the battleground. Power, space, and processing power constraints are quite significant for nodes in a sensor network. The adoption of appropriate routing algorithms is vital for lengthening the longevity of the sensor nodes. A common routing protocol could not be appropriate for sensor networks through all tasks, despite the fact that sensors are designed exclusively for surveillance and delivering activities. And the proto- cols elucidate the interaction of nodes with one another and the spreading of data among them throughout the network. The wireless communication sector has developed dozens of novel routing algorithms over the past 15 years that were aimed at the various designing domain possibilities. This paper demonstrates variety of routing protocols, which includes data centric, hierarchical, location based and Quality of Service (QoS) based protocols, employed in WSNs. Our framework’s objective is to inspect the WSNs and throw light on the classification of protocols. The paper is concluded with the future possibilities of such protocols in WSNs.

articleTitle: Validating Two-Tier Concept Inventory on Basics of Electronics Engineering using Rasch Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: This paper presents the validation of a two-tier basic electronics concept inventory (BECI) using the popular probabilistic Rasch model. The BECI is developed under this study to measure the conceptual knowledge of freshmen engineering students who studied introductory electronics. The main purpose of this research work is to prove the construct validity of BECI based on whether it measures conceptual knowledge or not and the second testing parameter is item fit reliability in which the difficulty level of all the test items of BECI should be mapped with the student’s ability level on a linear scale. The BECI is administered over 733 engineering students in online mode using Google form under the supervision of faculty and data is analyzed using SPSS software. The positive correlation under the Unidimensionality parameter computed by analyzing students’ post-test scores in BECI using the Rasch model indicates that it is measuring conceptual knowledge. The value of the BECI item fit reliability computed using the Rasch model is 0.84, which indicates that most of the test items of the BECI Instrument fit well to the Rasch dichotomous model. Wright map constructed for BECI post-test score versus student’s ability using Ministep software indicates the moderate level of mapping of item difficulty level with the student’s ability. The overall conclusion is the research analysis gives an insight into BECI validity based on Unidimensionality and item fit reliability so that it can be adopted by engineering educators to measure the conceptual knowledge of students to make them better future engineers in terms of problem-solving skills and improve cognition level.

articleTitle: Detection of different Crops Types using RapidEye Imagery over Fresno, California
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Monitoring the crops periodically and implementing sustainable agricultural practices are the considerable conditions for implementing efficient methodologies for Cropland Mapping. Detection of crop type, acreage calculation, and yield detection are the key research points that are under consideration of the research in today’s era. In this research work, the authors have focused on exploring the ability of Rapid-Eye data satellite images for crop identification/classification. A hybrid crop classification model was proposed for temporal and multispectral RapidEye imagery over the area of Fresno county of California state, United States. The studied area is enriched in a specific crop such as grapes, almonds, alfalfa, and dbl crop winwht/corn that covers 47.34%, 26.93%, 8.79%, and 3.51% of the area respectively. The ground truth data can be downloaded from the United States Department of Agriculture, CropScape-Cropland Data Layer by specifying a few parameters such as year, and area of interest (based on region, state, and county). The proposed classification model was designed by introducing the combination of a convolutional 1-D layer and two Gated Recurrent Unit layers and is aimed to obtain the best performance in terms of quantitative parameters. The authors introduced these layers to predict class probabilities based on a temporal sequence of observations. The proposed model outperforms for time-series data and resulted in a noticeable improvement in an overall accuracy of 96.31% and a kappa coefficient of 0.95.

articleTitle: A Survey on Blockchain for Bitcoin and Its Future Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The term cryptocurrency refers to a digital currency based on cryptographic concepts that have become popular in recent years. Bitcoin is a decentralized cryptocurrency that uses the distributed append-only public database known as blockchain to record every transaction. The incentive-compatible Proof-of-Work (PoW)-centered decentralized consensus procedure, which is upheld by the network's nodes known as miners, is essential to the safety of bitcoin. Interest in Bitcoin appears to be growing as the market continues to rise. Bitcoins and Blockchains have identical fundamental ideas, which are briefly discussed in this paper. Various studies discuss blockchain as a revolutionary innovation that has various applications, spanning from bitcoins to smart contracts, and also about it being a solution to many issues. Furthermore, many papers are reviewed here that not only look at Bitcoin’s fundamental underpinning technologies, such as Mixing and the Bitcoin Wallets but also at the flaws in it.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System in IoT Network by using Metaheuristic Algorithm with Machine Learning Dimensional Reduction Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: The network security is a main problem in any disseminated framework. To providing the safe and secure network we have been proposed anomaly detection system against from the suspicious attacks. The essential goal of this exploration is to plan effective IDS for IoT organization. The interruption discovery assumes a fundamental part in recognizing various assaults on IoT and upgrades the IoT performance. In this paper, one of the metaheuristic algorithms GSO (glow-worm swarm optimization) algorithm add with machine learning technique PCA (principal component analysis) used for providing the IDS. Therefore, the metaheuristic-based intrusion discovery model to recognize malicious activities by utilizing the NSL-KDD dataset. Dimensional reduction technique Principal component analysis is utilized for extraction of features and GSO algorithm is utilized to classify the various class of malicious attacks in the dataset. We have considered some metrics like precision, detection rate, recall, accuracy and FAR are computed. The suggested method evaluated better in each parameter compared with other existing techniques.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Energy Efficient and Secured Virtual Machine Allocation Model in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Ensuring security in cloud systems is one of the most significant tasks for users facing security problems in load balancing. Many conventional works have developed secured load balancing models for allocating Virtual Machines (VMs) in cloud systems. Still, it limits by the problems of high migration overhead, increased processing time, storage complexity, high energy consumption, and lack of security. So, the proposed work objects to implement an energy-efficient and secured Artificial Intelligence (AI) based VM allocation model for cloud load balancing. The novel contribution of this work is to develop an Intelligent Mine Blow Optimization (IBMO) technique to securely allocate the VMs in the cloud. Also, it helps to mitigate the security risks created by the attacks of VMs from multiple users. Moreover, it maintains the workloads among all VMs in the cloud server. The primary advantages of this work are reduced energy consumption, resource consumption, and overhead. During analysis, the performance and results of the proposed IBMO-based VM allocation model are validated and compared using various evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Space Optical Communication Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Nowadays communication era demands a high bandwidth, enhance performance with less attenuation and high capacity. Although these demands can be completed with optical fiber but due to some advantages of Free Space Optic (FSO), it was widely used now days. FSO communication is a subfield of optics that involves sending and receiving information using light as the source of the signal. FSO was devised as a solution to the limiting factor that existed in optical fiber and RF engineering. FSO technology has drawn the attention of various Telco’s since it can be used to solve the last mile problem in busy metropolises. This paper is focused on detailed survey of FSO system, its advantage, disadvantage, and application. Different modulation schemes related paper was studies and compare its used parameter and discussed its results in table. As a result, it has been seen that CS-RZ modulation gave best performance as compared to others modulation techniques.

Author Keywords: Wireless Communication System and Radio Frequency

articleTitle: Analysis of Micro Expressions using XAI
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Micro Expressions refer to the minuscule flinches that occur on an individual’s face as an innate response to a stimulus. Unlike Macro Expressions that last for anywhere between 0.5 to 2 second, Micro Expressions last for less than half a second, their amplitude is also extremely minute. Their brevity coupled with subtleness, makes it hard to capture them with a naked eye, let alone identify and classify them. Recent advancements in deep learning models have allowed researchers to isolate frames from micro expression videos and feed them to these models, which in turn classify them with high precision and accuracy. However, deep learning algorithms are black-boxes as users are unable to completely understand their underlying functioning and calculations involved. This poses a challenge to the reliability and accountability of the model. eXplainable AI or XAI models have been revolutionary in solving this problem. In this paper we have implemented the LIME model, combined with a VGG16 deep learning model. This compiled architecture has not only been able to detect micro-expressions accurately but has also provided suitable explanations for the results achieved. To corroborate our findings further, we have employed an OpenCV algorithm. The problem with micro expression detection is the short life span of these expressions as well as the inability to produce or hide them on command. Arising as reactions to stimuli, it is only possible to study them empirically with heavy dependence on a high speed cameras and intensive manual studies. Incorporating XAI in this domain will help increase the throughput capacity of micro expression analysis.

articleTitle: Survey on use of Augmented Reality in Early Childhood Education: Teachers Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Learner motivation and engagement plays an important role in effective learning. Selecting the right teaching strategies to increase engagement and motivation are equally important. Innovations in multimedia, technology, computers and internet have given rise to the use of new methods and tools in the classroom. Augmented reality is an instrumental tool used by educators to teach their students. As technology changes and is part of the curriculum, augmented reality finds space as a learning tool to increase student engagement and motivation. This study will help researchers and developers acquire valuable knowledge to understand the various challenges of early learning from a teacher's perspective. It will help understand how the use of Augmented Reality technology can help improve student engagement, motivation and academic performance and understand the limitations in existing applications that need to be addressed while developing AR applications for early stages.

articleTitle: Survey Paper on IoT based Intrusion Detection System: Datasets and Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: As the pervasiveness of IoT devices in intelligent applications, traditional cybersecurity protection strategies cannot be directly applied. Additionally, the heterogeneity, dynamics, and scalability of these devices require sophisticated security and protection strategies. Motivated by these factors, we examine current security and privacy mechanisms to provide an overview of both academic and industrial domains and pave the way for further investigation. In this article, we discuss IoT devices, their uses, and how to protect these devices with an intrusion detection system developed using different datasets and different machine learning techniques. At the same time, it addresses existing intrusion detection systems which detect and classify various attacks in a timely and automated manner, especially with the continuously growth in number of attacks due to nature of data used in different IoT gadgets and its complexity of network.

articleTitle: Editorial: 3rd Edition of the Flagship Engineering Conference of Chitkara University, Punjab India Organized in November 2022 with Technical Sponsorship from IEEE
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Computing, Analytics and Networks (ICAN)
abstract: Third edition of the International Conference on Computing Analytics and Networks – ICAN 2022, which is one of the flagship engineering conferences of Chitkara University was organized on November 18 and 19, 2022 with technical sponsorship from IEEE. ICAN 2022 witnessed pan India participation as well as participation of authors from 5 different countries and was attended by 200 delegates in the physical and virtual modes combined. The aim of this editorial is to give an insight about the technical program of the conference as well as to give an overview of the invited talks and experts talks that were held during the conference. ICAN 2022 featured 57 paper presentations and 8 invited and expert talks. Additionally, the details about the theme of the conference, background of the conference and enabling ecosystem of the host institution for organizing successful academic conferences have been included in this editorial.
